artist.name: Uday Kapur
artist.bio: Uday Kapur is a music journalist and the co-founder, with Mo Joshi, of Azadi Records, the label set up in 2017. On boxout.fm he presented Minority Report, a show on hip-hop and other emerging scenes from Asia and the Global South, and he played a guest mix of Indian hip-hop for NTS in Delhi in 2018.

eras.sound: Hip-hop and grime from Asian and Global South scenes

press.title: India's most exciting music label doesn't want to produce hits, and that's a good thing
Azadi Records Are Taking No Prisoners
